about: The introitus of the formulary “Holy Family of Jesus, Mary, and Joseph” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let the father of the Just One rejoice with gladness; let Thy Father and Thy Mother be glad, and let her that bore Thee rejoice. How lovely are Thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts! My soul longeth and fainteth for the courts of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Let the father of the Just One rejoice with gladness; let Thy Father and Thy Mother be glad, and let her that bore Thee rejoice.
